subject: Chemistry
q: The graph shows the boundary of saturation for a salt in terms of the equilibrium concentrations of ions X and Y. Which pair gives the salt stoichiometry and its solubility product, respectively?
imgAlt: Decreasing solubility curve of [Y] in mM against [X] in mM, passing through [X] = 1 mM and [Y] = 2 mM.
hint: Use the point [X] = 1 mM, [Y] = 2 mM and identify which ionic-product expression remains constant along the curve.
solution: The curve is consistent with Ksp = [X][Y]², so the salt is XY₂. At [X] = 1 × 10⁻³ M and [Y] = 2 × 10⁻³ M, Ksp = (1 × 10⁻³)(2 × 10⁻³)² = 4 × 10⁻⁹ M³.
